items.item: The form is split into titled sections (personal, job and contract, bank and tax, emergency contact, documents) in a single column, with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: SECTIONS render <section><h2> titles: Thông tin cá nhân, Công việc và hợp đồng, Ngân hàng và thuế, Người liên hệ khẩn cấp, plus Giấy tờ. Fields are stacked in space-y-6, one per row. Every field has <label class="mb-1 block"> above it (the radio group uses aria-labelledby). Placeholders are only example values.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional fields are labelled as optional or left unmarked by a stated convention
items.evidence: Required labels get ' *' and the form shows the legend '* Bắt buộc' above the sections. Docs use '(bắt buộc)'. The optional fields (Mã số thuế, Số sổ BHXH, Số người phụ thuộc) are left unmarked, which follows the legend, and their help text says they can be left blank.

items.item: Field widths match their content: dates, postal codes and tax codes are narrow; inputs use the right types (email, tel, date)
items.evidence: Dates use type=date at w-40. CCCD, phone, tax code, BHXH and account number use w-56. Dependants uses w-28. Email is type=email and phone fields are type=tel. Names and addresses use max-w-xl. There is no postal code field.

items.item: An option to save the form as a draft is offered, and saving a draft does not demand every required field
items.evidence: #draftBtn 'Lưu nháp'. Its handler does not call validateAll. It clears errors, shows 'Đã lưu nháp HH:MM' and a toast.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable while scrolling (a sticky bar or equivalent), Save is a verb label and is not disabled before submitting
items.evidence: The action bar is 'sticky bottom-0' with Hủy, Lưu nháp and the primary 'Tạo hồ sơ nhân viên' (a verb phrase). It is visible at the bottom of the first-viewport screenshot. #saveBtn is disabled only while submitting (busy), not before. The audit's sticky-inert check raised no violation.

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with several errors a summary at the top links to each field and focus moves to the first invalid field
items.evidence: The form's focusout listener calls validateField. The submit handler calls validateAll(), then focusField(errs[0].id). renderSummary shows '{n} trường cần chỉnh sửa' with links (data-jump / href=#id) when there are 3 or more errors. The click handler focuses the target field.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning
items.evidence: window 'beforeunload' calls preventDefault when dirty. guardedLeave() shows an alertdialog ('Bạn có thay đổi chưa lưu. Rời trang mà không lưu?') for nav links and Hủy. A 'Có thay đổi chưa lưu' indicator is also shown.

items.item: The document upload states accepted file types and the size limit, lists chosen files with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: The text reads 'Định dạng PDF, JPG hoặc PNG, tối đa 5 MB mỗi tệp.' and the input has accept='.pdf,.jpg,.jpeg,.png'. Files over 5 MB are rejected with a toast. The docs table lists file name, type and size, with a 'Xóa' button (aria-label 'Xóa <file>') that opens a confirm dialog. Upload, view and download are real <button> elements that click a hidden file input, so they work from the keyboard.

items.item: Success is confirmed with a message that names the employee and is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: The submit handler calls toast('Hồ sơ nhân viên NV-2026-0143 (' + fullName + ') đã được tạo'). The #toast container is role='status' and is present in the DOM before the message is injected.

notes: No template tells found: plain white sidebar, small radii (4px; dialogs rounded-lg), a single blue accent, no gradient apart from the skeleton shimmer, no emoji icons, no KPI tiles or greeting header. The initials avatar is a real person (LH). Audit score is 100 with no violations. Minor caveats: the error summary appears only when there are 3 or more errors (with 1-2 errors the inline messages and focus move are the only cue). The date input shows mm/dd/yyyy in the screenshot because of browser locale. The success toast disappears after 4s. The draft save clears all error messages.
